{{Quote|You've used ''my'' reputation to forge your own little empire, ''Soopan''!''"<br />"''I&hellip; I just wanted a taste of real ''power''! You'd been gone so long that no-one could remember your ''face''&mdash;but your ''name'' still scares everyone silly!|[[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] and Soopan|<ref name="Bane vs ...Bane?" />}}
'''Soopan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] from the [[City/Legends|city]] [[New Tayana]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Duro/Legends|Duro]] who was at one time the best friend of [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]]. After Bane left Duro and established himself as a successful [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], Soopan capitalized on his former friend's reputation by masquerading as Bane and using the [[Hunting/Legends|hunter's]] identity to become the leader of a criminal operation within New Tayana's [[Descent Ghetto]].<ref name="Bane vs ...Bane?" />

Under his guise as Bane, Soopan became wanted by the local [[Unidentified New Tayana sheriff|sheriff]] and, during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the real Bane journeyed to Duro to track down his former associate. Bane located Soopan within the Descent Ghetto, and Soopan [[Raid on the Descent Shopping Mall|engaged]] in a firefight with him and turned large numbers of his minions on Bane. However, Bane defeated Soopan's forces and confronted his old friend on the last floor of the [[Descent Shopping Mall]], telling him he had to earn the right to steal something as valuable as his reputation.<ref name="Bane vs ...Bane?" />

Bane then gave Soopan one of his [[LL-30 blaster pistol/Legends|LL-30 blaster pistols]] and, in memory of better times, granted him one last shot at power, giving him the choice to decide how the story would end for him.<ref name="Bane vs ...Bane?" /> Soopan chose to commit [[Death/Legends|suicide]].<ref name="TOLM" />

Bane later declared that when the dust settled, there was only one Bane standing, and that he was in no mood to celebrate.<ref name="Bane vs ...Bane?" />
